en: Changed auto mode behind an LLM gateway: `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1` turns on the server-side check even with `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS` set; if managed settings set the latter, they must set the `1` too
zh: 变更了位于 LLM 网关之后的自动模式：即使设置了 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS`，`CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1` 也会开启服务端检查；如果托管设置设置了后者，则必须同时设置 `1`
